name: "Eat Your Veggies" Sweet Potato-Broccoli Chicken Nuggets with BBQ Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place bread crumbs in a small bowl. Set aside.
Wash, dry, peel, and coarsely grate sweet potato. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, and coarsely grate broccoli. Add to the bowl with the sweet potato along with chicken and spices. Mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 crown broccoli
454 g ground chicken
2 tsp chili powder
1 tsp onion powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a generous tablespoon measure, form the chicken mixture into 2-inch nugget shapes. Add to the bowl with the bread crumbs, turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere, and place on a plate. Repeat with remaining chicken and bread crumbs.

Spray air fryer basket with cooking spray. Working in batches to best fit the size of your air fryer, add nuggets to the basket, spacing them at least ½-inch apart. Coat nuggets with additional cooking spray.
Insert basket into the air fryer and set temperature to 400°F. Cook, flipping halfway, until nuggets are golden, crispy, and cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove basket from air fryer.
Divide nuggets between plates and serve with barbecue sauce for dipping. Enjoy!
